sections.Profile:
"World Cup" is a solid-state pinball machine released by Williams Electronic Games Inc. in March 1978. Designed by Edward Tomaszewski with artwork by Christian Marche and sound by Randy Pfeiffer, this machine was notable for being the first Williams pinball game to feature electronic sounds instead of traditional chimes, marking a significant technological shift for the company. The game has a soccer theme and includes features like two flippers, pop bumpers, rollover buttons, kick-out holes, standup targets, and a spinning target.
